unconsidered_routes.title: Diegetic text as DOM anchored by the existing projection, not WebGL sprites
unconsidered_routes.proposal: Render NPC bubbles, lace pages and ambient lines as absolutely positioned DOM nodes updated once per rAF from RenderFrame.entityPoses[i].headAnchorWorldPosition run through projectWorldToNdc (compute only for the <=N speakers, not all entities, and not just in debugMode). Use transform: translate3d on pooled elements and CSS for the parchment skin; run it in the same rAF after buildFrame so there is no one-frame lag.
unconsidered_routes.reference: Disco Elysium and Crusader Kings style DOM/Canvas UI over a WebGL scene; Three CSS2DRenderer pattern
unconsidered_routes.replaces_or_changes: Avoids canvas-texture sprites (one draw call plus texture upload per bubble, blurry at DPR 1) and gives SLM-length text, wrapping, accessibility and reduced-motion for free. Only the inspector cards use the projection today.

unconsidered_routes.title: Authored-hero plus merged-crowd character tiers
unconsidered_routes.proposal: Keep the 7-part kitbash for Tier 1/2, but build Tier 3 ambient_crowd as one merged BufferGeometry per costume archetype with vertex colours, shared across all crowd members through InstancedMesh with instanceColor and per-instance matrices. Pool instances in the resident space and drive them from the same entityPoses.
unconsidered_routes.reference: Assassin's Creed / Hitman crowd tiers; Three.js InstancedMesh with instanceColor
unconsidered_routes.replaces_or_changes: Replaces per-NPC 7-mesh groups for the crowd, collapsing ~4.5 draw calls per NPC to one per archetype and removing per-material highlight problems for bystanders.

unconsidered_routes.title: Interpolation via a tiny render-state buffer owned by PlaySession
unconsidered_routes.proposal: Have the fixed-step loop write a flat Float32Array of {x,y,z,yaw,teleportEpoch} per resident entity at each tick (prev and curr swapped), and let buildFrame lerp from that buffer with alpha. The buffer also gives the renderer a stable entity ordering without sorting object keys per frame.
unconsidered_routes.reference: Glenn Fiedler 'Fix Your Timestep' with render-state snapshots (Overwatch ECS netcode, Unity interpolated rigidbodies)
unconsidered_routes.replaces_or_changes: Replaces the Object.keys().sort() + zod + object-literal pose path with typed arrays, and satisfies the hardening batch's golden-run requirement because the buffer is presentation-only and not in the hashed state.
